value.rationale: The exact non-Gaussian tail law answers a motivated gap: known multivariate Gaussian fluctuations mimic independent uniform-box counts, but the sharp atypical singular-value tail is proven to depart exponentially and with opposite signs above/below typical growth. This distinguishes rare expansion and rare underexpansion in a canonical twisting map, with a continuous rate and explicit algebraic mechanism; it is not just a parameter substitution or single small numerical improvement.
